ISO 8601 Converter

Convert between local datetimes, ISO 8601 variants (UTC, offset, date-only) and Unix timestamps.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a datetime, ISO string, or Unix timestamp.
  2. Click Convert.
  3. Copy whichever output format you need.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which timezone is used for local input?

The picker's timezone is your browser's local zone; UTC variants are converted explicitly.

Can I convert a Unix timestamp back?

Yes — timestamps in seconds and milliseconds are converted to full ISO dates.

Seconds or milliseconds input?

Both — the parser detects second vs millisecond magnitude automatically.

Does it handle ISO week dates?

No — week dates (2026-W40) and ordinal dates are not handled; use standard RFC 3339-style input.
